''"Professor Umiam Gorelox? of Scipio?|A Lanupa security officer talking to Jod Na Nawood|}} During the [[New Republic Era]], a '''human''' worked as a security officer at [[Skull Ridge Mountain Hotel & Spa]] on the [[planet]] of [[Lanupa]]. Around [[9 ABY]], they confronted [[Jod Na Nawood]] for impersonating [[Professor]] [[Umiam Gorelox]]. ==Biography== {{Quote|Halt, Dash Zentin! AKA Mad Captain Silvo. AKA Jodwick Zank.|A Lanupa security officer talking to Jod Na Nawood|}} They were a [[human]] security officer at the [[Skull Ridge Mountain Hotel & Spa]] on the [[planet]] of [[Lanupa]]. Around [[9 ABY]],{{SkeletonCrewDate}} they approached the [[Scoundrel/Legends|scoundrel]] [[Jod Na Nawood]] and [[youngling]]s [[KB]], [[Neel]] asking if he was in fact [[Professor]] [[Umiam Gorelox]] from [[Scipio]]. When Na Nawood and his companions ran away from the officer they called more guards who cornered the group on a walkway at the spa's [[Mud Pits]]. The youngling [[KB]] used a wrench to cause a mud pipe to spew mud at the group of guards causing them to fall into the mud pits. At the same time Na Nawood knocked out the officer with a punch and the group made their escape. ==Personality and traits== They were a human with short [[Color|brown]] [[hair]], blue [[eye]]s and light skin. ==Equipment== While working at the spa, they wore a [[Color|green]] [[Clothing|uniform]] with a white [[helmet]], white [[belt]] and white [[glove]]s. ==Behind the scenes== The officer appeared in ''[[You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates]]'', a ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'' episode that premiered on [[December 25]], [[2024]] and was portrayed by [[Brandon Bales]]. ==Appearances== *{{SkeletonCrew|You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=ლანუპას დაცვის უცნობი ოფიცერი }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
